REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
  ORANGE COUNTY, CALIFORNIA

  Tuesday, April 9, 2024,9 : 0 0 A . M .

  BOARD HEARING ROOM, FIRST FLOOR
  400 W. Civic Center Drive
  Santa Ana, California

  DONALD P. WAGNER
  CHAIRMAN
  Third District

 DOUG CHAFFEE  ANDREW DO
 VICE CHAIRMAN  SUPERVISOR
 Fourth District  First District

 VICENTE SARMIENTO  KATRINA
 SUPERVISOR  FOLEY
 Second District  SUPERVISOR
  Fifth District
ATTENDANCE:Supervisors Sarmiento, Chaffee and Wagner

EXCUSED:Supervisors Do and Foley

 PRESENT:  COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER  Frank Kim
  COUNTY COUNSEL  Leon J. Page
  CLERK OF THE BOARD  Robin Stieler

INVOCATION:Vice Chairman Chaffee, Fourth District, gave the invocation

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:Chairman Wagner, Third District, led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance

I.PRESENTATIONS/INTRODUCTIONS

 Chairman Wagner and Supervisor Sarmiento presented a resolution proclaiming April 2024 as "Child
 Abuse Prevention Month"

 Vice Chairman Chaffee presented a resolution recognizing April 2024 as "DMV/Donate Life Month"

 Chairman Wagner presented a resolution celebrating Orange County Probation Department's 115th
 Birthday

II.CONSENT CALENDAR (Items 1-4)

X

23145  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X X

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

  County Executive Office:

21.  Approve lease agreement with Spectrum Property Owner, LLC for office space for

IV.PUBLIC HEARINGS (Items 25-27)

OC COMMUNITY RESOURCES

 25.  Public Hearing to consider approving Permanent Local Housing Allocation Program Years 3
  and 4 Allocation Application including Reuse Plan, budget revision and substantial
  amendment to Permanent Local Housing Allocation Five-Year Plan and year 1 budget
  revision form; authorize Director or designee to reallocate 10% of funding per allocation
  Years 1 through 4 to County Emergency Shelter Programs; adopt resolution authorizing
  Director or designee to execute and submit application and related documents and
  subsequent amendments to California Department of Housing and Community Development
  for Permanent Local Housing Allocation Years 3 and 4 Funds, authorizing receipt of grant
  funds ($2,175,998 and $1,090,616 respectively) and adopting substantial amendment
   removing San Juan Capistrano Allocation and activity; and authorize Director or designee to
  submit additional applications to State of California Housing and Community Development
  Department for up to full amount of Years 3 and 4 Permanent Local Housing Allocation
  Program funds and other related documents - All Districts (Continued from 3/26/24, Item 35)

  XX

VI.PUBLIC, CEO, ADJOURNMENT & BOARD COMMENTS

PUBLIC COMMENTS:

Steve Rocco - Oral Re: Walked in the woods as a child and saw a fake rifle against a tree; Rifleman
and other cowboy television shows; toy guns prepared boys to be soldiers; fake work; McCain on
Rifleman taught his son values and nationhood

Meredith Chellemi - Oral Re: Chair of the Older Adults Advisory Commission; provided overview of
the Commission's activities from January - March 2024; commission changed their bylaws and
modernized commission name and structure to spend more time in the community for gaps and
services of older adults; California Department of Aging survey showed older adults do not know
where to turn for help; Brown Act overview provided by County Counsel

Rachel Owens - Oral Re: Serves on the Older Adults Advisory Commission; activities of the
commission and the quality of those serving on the commission; Care GiverResource Center works
with commission to inform older adults of resources available; asked Office on Aging to create
PowerPoint for the commission members to use at senior centers and to present at City Council
meetings and other community locations; wants to work with Office on Aging and the Board to create
a public outreach campaign

Gabriella Hidalgo Vega - Oral Re: Camino Nuevo provides mental health services; wrote letter to the
Director of the facility regarding issues with the program but has not received a response; requested
facility be reviewed and identify services to be provided by the facility

Debbie McGuire - Oral Re: Executive Director of the Wetlands and Wildlife Care Center in
Huntington Beach; requested additional money be provided by the County in order to keep the center
open

Ilya Tseglin - Oral Re: Demanded the Chairman resign and remove his license to practice law;
victimized from criminals Larry Landauer, Nancy Bartman, court administrators and law enforcement;
County is run by corporate shareholders to steal fruit of labor, family, property, liberty and life

Kate - Oral Re: Criteria for conviction in a criminal trial is proof beyond a reasonable doubt; read from
Steve Umfleet book; demand for transparency in elections; Yale Navigation Center entrance
requirements

Eileen McDonald - Oral Re: Betrayal towards those who approved of the election fraud in 2020 and
2022 elections including the Board, county, city and elected officials; asked why was there pushback if
   election was legitimate; Syrians hacked 2020 election; Google interfered with elections 42 times in the
  last 15 years; pray for elected officials

  Bryan Kaye - Oral Re: Reported violation of 'never again'; criminal defense attorney labeling a client
  mentally ill; intentionally violating the law and allowing hate crimes to continue

  Roseann - Oral Re: Orange County Chair of New California State and Orange County Freedom Caucus
  member; election fraud continues; letter from Registrar of Voters stating signature does not match and
  was denied to vote; dead people voting, change of address not matching and ineligible voters
